html: A uniform plane electromagnetic wave incident normally on a plane surface of a dielectric material is reflected with a VSWR of 3. What is the percentage of incident power that is reflected?
subject: Electromagnetics - Transmission Lines
explanation_text: [latex]\begin{aligned} s&=\frac{1+|\Gamma|}{1-|\Gamma|} \\ \Rightarrow 3&=\frac{1+|\Gamma|}{1-|\Gamma|} \\ |\Gamma|&=0.5 \\ \frac{P_{r}}{P_{i}}&=|\Gamma|^{2}=0.25 \end{aligned}[/latex] [latex] \therefore \quad 25 \% [/latex] of incident power is reflected.

subject: Electromagnetics - Antennas
explanation_text: [latex]\theta_{\max }=60^{\circ}[/latex] from end fire means 60^{\circ} from array axis.\\ Condition for maximum, [latex]\psi \rightarrow 0 [/latex] [latex] \begin{array}{l} E_{T}=E_{O} \frac{\sin \left(N_{\psi} / 2\right)}{\sin (\psi / 2)} \\ E_{T}=N E_{0}=E_{\max } \\ \psi=\alpha+\beta d \cos 60^{\circ}=0 \\ \alpha+\frac{2 \pi}{\lambda} \cdot \frac{\lambda}{4} \cdot \frac{1}{2}=0 \\ \alpha=-\frac{\pi}{4} \end{array}[/latex]
